details.description: grok-imagine-image-quality is one of three image models xAI offers in its Grok Imagine image family, also reachable under the aliases grok-imagine-image-quality-20260403, grok-imagine-image-quality-latest and grok-imagine-image-pro. Per xAI's own model documentation, it is a text-to-image generation system that also accepts an image input, so it can generate new images from a prompt or edit a supplied image from a natural-language description. xAI's own model-selection guide recommends its sibling model, grok-imagine-image-2.0, rather than this quality tier, as the default choice for image generation tasks. xAI has scheduled this model for retirement on November 2, 2026, after which requests to it will automatically be served by grok-imagine-image-2.0 at low quality, per xAI's migration guide.
advantages: Accepts both a text prompt and an image input to the same endpoint, so it can generate a new image or edit a supplied one, per xAI's grok-imagine-image-quality model documentation.
Also reachable under the aliases grok-imagine-image-quality-20260403, grok-imagine-image-quality-latest and grok-imagine-image-pro, per xAI's model documentation.
Generates images at three selectable resolutions -- 1024x1024, 1408x1408 and 2048x2048 -- per xAI's model documentation.
disadvantages: xAI's own model-selection guide recommends grok-imagine-image-2.0 rather than this quality tier as the default model for image generation, per docs.x.ai.
Does not support xAI's Batch API, unlike the grok-imagine-image-2.0 model, per xAI's model documentation.
Rate-limited to 6 requests per second, per xAI's model documentation.
xAI is retiring this model on November 2, 2026; after that date, requests to grok-imagine-image-quality are automatically served by grok-imagine-image-2.0 at low quality, per xAI's migration guide.
use_cases: Generating a new image from a text prompt.
Editing a supplied image from a natural-language description.

notes: xAI's migration guide (docs.x.ai/docs/migration/imagine-image-quality-nov-2) confirms the catalog's 2026-11-02 deprecation_date: xAI is retiring grok-imagine-image-quality on that date and will then serve its requests with grok-imagine-image-2.0 at low quality. This corrects the prior note that no deprecation notice could be found. The cited grok-imagine-image-quality model page also lists per-resolution pricing (1024x1024, 1408x1408, 2048x2048), so resolution is no longer omitted; text-rendering details are still not stated anywhere in xAI's current docs and remain omitted. The grok-imagine-image-2.0 model page was checked to confirm it supports the Batch API, unlike this model. Per the brief, no price figures are included even though xAI's pages list them.
